target_issue: Missing/incorrect implementation of T33: no HMAC with secret and no now<=expires_at check in verify_path_token (tests added do not cover these requirements).
thoughts: I need to inspect the PR diff and run the test suite to ensure the new functions meet T33 requirements without breaking legacy behavior.
